The Push to Free a Princeton Scientist From ICE Detention Is Growing

Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) detained a Princeton University doctoral candidate on Nov. 19 at an airport in Arlington, Virginia. Her colleagues, classmates, and lawmakers are calling for her immediate release ahead of Thanksgiving Weekend. Eva Yi Xie, a Chinese national, was detained at the Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport as she departed from an annual conference of the Society for Neuroscience.
